english.title: Fail to remove / reposition a builder's skip
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been required under section 140(2) of the Highways Act 1980 to

(A)_[remove a builder's skip,]_
(B)_[reposition a builder's skip,]_
(C)_[cause a builder's skip to be removed,]_
(D)_[cause a builder's skip to be repositioned,]_

failed to comply with the requirement as soon as practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to section 140(3) of the Highways Act 1980.
